name: Kuroda Sayuki
source:
She is an otaku who aims to make a bishoujo game, is an odd loner who is frank, assertive and a bit condescending. She always like to wear black. She is also Bunta's classmate, whom she recruited to help her in making a bishoujo game.

Position: Producer
Occupation: Class 2-2
Favorite Food: Coffee
Special Skill: Arranging [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rubik's_Cube]Three Dimensional Cube[/url]
Important Thing: Family
Hated Thing: Collusion
